cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Terms and Conditions
cards.instruction: Treat every offer, favor, feeling, and apology as a negotiation.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll sort the ladder loan out. Two lifts to the station and it's yours for the afternoon.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I only need it for five minutes. Two lifts is too much.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: One, then. I can make a sensible adjustment. You choose the morning and I'll be ready at the kerb.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'd rather pay you than promise a lift.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Five pounds will settle it. Three if you hand it over with 'thanks, friend.' We can call that my regular-customer rate if you prefer.
